definitions.explanation: The formal act of wearing or putting on clothing, accessories, or protective equipment. Used primarily in official instructions, regulations, and formal contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦ヘルメット→ヘルメット：11325_herumetto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{着用|ちゃくよう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安全靴|あんぜんぐつ}→安全靴：24184_anzengutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{着用|ちゃくよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧づけられて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Wearing safety shoes is mandatory in the factory.

examples.japanese: ⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{着用|ちゃくよう}⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦お{客様|きゃくさま}→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご⟦{入店|にゅうてん}→入店：22089_nyuuten⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦{断|ことわ}り→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: We do not allow customers who are not wearing masks to enter the store.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word for wearing or putting on items. In everyday conversation, ⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧, {被|かぶ}る, ⟦{履|は}く→履く：00700_haku⟧, or ⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ would be used depending on the item. {着用|ちゃくよう} is preferred in written notices, safety regulations, and official instructions. It is used for all types of wearable items regardless of where on the body they are worn.

WRITING:
⟦{着|ちゃく}→着：27655_chaku⟧ means "to wear" or "to arrive" and ⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ means "to use." Together they convey the formal sense of putting something on for use.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{着用|ちゃくよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to wear a mask
- ⟦ヘルメット→ヘルメット：11325_herumetto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{着用|ちゃくよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to wear a helmet
- {着用|ちゃくよう}⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧: obligation to wear
- {着用|ちゃくよう}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: prohibited from wearing
